speaker: thomas_pope
text: You are through the door. Stay through it. The yard is loud enough without a man telling his own exit back to us.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not telling it. I was out there, and now I am here. Here is a bench, a pot, and a coat that still has its stitch.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am off for a little, too. I will not ask what they did with the laugh. I heard it through the cloth. Hearing is not going out to look.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not go out to look. Thou art not the crowd, and neither am I. If the laugh was ours, it can spend itself without a witness from this side.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Sit, then. Your next is not yet. Take the pot off your brow if it itches. Leave it if the itch is only vanity.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It itches. Vanity can wait until I am plain again on purpose. Nick, if thou hast a line left in thy mouth, leave it there. This room is not a second yard.
